description: Release version headers on every /api/node/v1 request and response, errors included. The node sends its release version; while the coordinator enforces a release policy it answers with the latest published release and the minimum release still offered new jobs (the release before latest, and never below the node-v2 protocol floor 0.1.17), and tells a node older than the minimum that it must update. Such a node still authenticates, heartbeats and finishes work it holds, but gets no leases until it updates. A heartbeat in an older protocol (version node-v1) is held for its wait_seconds and answered 426 update_required (error-update-required.json) with Scarlett-Node-Update-Required: true. A node that sends no version is treated as legacy_node_version.
